premises.text: Web growth scattered content across sites and apps, forcing users into fragmented tab- and app-hopping instead of fluid surfing
premises.evidence_span: we've traded the fluidity and connectedness of surfing for stacks of browser tabs and single-purpose mobile apps

premises.text: VIRB weaves together the services people already use into one surfing experience on web and mobile
premises.evidence_span: reinvent surfing the internet on web or mobile by weaving together services you use

premises.text: VIRB generates interactive cards from third-party services and keeps activity in a persistent stream that shares context across services
premises.evidence_span: VIRB generates a card from services like IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes

premises.text: Activity streams can be saved into shareable collections that support collaborative planning and notifications
premises.evidence_span: I can also save this entire activity stream into a collection, which I can share publicly or, in this case, with just my team

premises.text: Semantic search and recommendations build contextual bridges across services
premises.evidence_span: To build these contextual bridges across services, we use data technologies like semantic search and recommendations

premises.text: New user interfaces and interaction paradigms are required alongside data technologies to weave services together
premises.evidence_span: We also design from the ground up new user interfaces and interaction paradigms

premises.text: VIRB syncs activity and data across devices and deep-links into native mobile apps
premises.evidence_span: VIRB syncs my activity and data across devices

value.text: Users get things done in one place by fluidly surfing across linked services on any screen
value.evidence_span: Verb is an intelligent layer over the internet that helps you get things done in one place

secondary_value.text: Bring back the magic of surfing from link to link across services and devices
secondary_value.evidence_span: bring back the magic of surfing, fluidly moving from link to link, service to service, on any screen or device

causal_links.evidence_span: when we can weave together these services, we can explore opportunities around this interconnected graph
why do we need to settle on a fragmented web
helps you get things done in one place
To build these contextual bridges across services, we use data technologies like semantic search and recommendations

notes: Demo feature list (cards, theaters, restaurants, judges research) folded into the core weaving/stream premises per §4.1(5). Vision of reinventing surfing coded as secondary_value, not a premise (§4.1(4)). Singleton D1 justified as separately revisable market fragmentation assumption.
